channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio libera abertura de sigilo após PT e cobra cartão corporativo de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro authorized the opening of secrecy after the PT delivered to the TSE the powers that allow bank and phone secrecy breaks, also demanding Lula's corporate card. The two campaigns have not yet officially opened their secrets.

item.title: Lula diante do maior desafio de sua vida
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva achieved an unprecedented path in Brazilian history, becoming the only union leader to found a political party and be elected president three times, including after being convicted and imprisoned for corruption. His life and career defy traditional political odds in Brazil.

item.title: Times de Brasil e Argentina farão final valendo hegemonia na Libertadores
item.description: The 2026 Libertadores final will be contested between Estudiantes (Argentina) and Palmeiras (Brazil) in a heated battle for continental supremacy, with both nations tied at 25 titles each. The match, on November 28 at the Centenario Stadium in Montevideo, will also determine which country has the most titles in the competition's history.

item.title: Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro: o que vai decidir a eleição mais acirrada da história - O Assunto #1831
item.description: The 2026 election between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remains tied after the first round, with polls suggesting a slight numerical edge for PL but a narrowing gap. The TV Globo debate will be pivotal for swaying undecided voters amid street protests and social media battles.

item.title: Lula comenta em post de Richarlison e cita “calote da ilha”
item.description: President Lula commented on Richarlison's post about the 2026 elections, referencing the 'island scam' and urging votes for PT. The athlete's publication addressed the importance of voting without directly naming the candidates, but generated symbolic association with Lula's supporters.

item.title: Campanha deixa de lado temas essenciais ao país
item.description: As the election campaign nears its end, candidates and strategists have omitted essential issues such as the pension crisis, fiscal adjustment, and concrete measures against organized crime. Both Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) prioritized personal attacks over substantive proposals, leaving voters without clear guidelines for the next government. The absence of these debates weakens the quality of the democratic choice.

item.title: Risco de contestação a resultado não vem apenas da direita
item.description: Brazil remains deeply divided between supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with tight 2026 elections ahead. Any victory will be contested, worsening social fragmentation. The post-election challenge will be rebuilding national unity and restoring democratic coexistence.

item.title: Lula tem 50,6% contra 49,4% de Flávio em votos válidos, diz Vox
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll released on October 22, 2026 shows Lula with 50.6% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 49,4 in the second round. The margin of error is 2.15 points with 95% confidence, based on 2,100 respondents.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 47,1% de rejeição e Lula, 44,8%, diz Vox Brasil
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading rejection rates at 47.1%, followed by President Lula (PT) at 44.8%. Conducted between October 20-22, the survey polled 2,100 voters with a ±2.15 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Respondents were asked which candidate they would not vote for under any circumstances.

item.title: Vox Brasil: Lula tem 50,6% dos votos válidos; Flávio Bolsonaro, 49,4%
item.description: Vox Brasil poll shows technical tie between Lula (50.6%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (49.4%) ahead of Sunday's presidential runoff, with a margin of error of 2.15 points. The race remains tight with elections just two days away.

item.title: Vox: Lula soma 50,6% dos votos válidos, contra 49,4% de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Vox poll released on 10/22 shows Lula with 50.6% of valid votes against 49.4% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff. The tie is within the technical error margin of 2.15 percentage points. The survey interviewed 2,100 voters from October 20-22, with 95% confidence.

item.title: O doador da campanha do PL que une Flávio Bolsonaro, Kassio e Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: A R$1 million donation to PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro exposed connections between him, the TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques, lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and lawyer Otto Medeiros, who is also linked to investigations into the medicinal cannabis trade.

item.title: Lula tem 50,6% dos votos válidos contra 49,4% de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz pesquisa Vox Brasil
item.description: Vox Brasil poll shows Lula with 50.6% of valid votes against 49.4% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second-round race. The 1.1-point gap is within the margin of error, with Lula at 45.4% and Flávio at 44.3% in the estimated scenario. Lula leads in the spontaneous poll and has lower rejection, while government approval rises slightly.

item.title: Entre o PIX de R$ 1 e as grandes doações: o que mudou no financiamento das campanhas presidenciais de 2022 a 2026
item.description: TSE data reveals distinct funding models between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 elections: while Flávio relies on few donors with high donations, Lula expanded its contributor base and reduced resource concentration among major donors. Flávio's campaign follows a pattern opposite to Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, prioritizing significant corporate and individual donations over small collective contributions.

item.title: 34% dos doadores da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro financiaram também Jair em 2022; Lula teve 1,4% de recorrência nas duas eleições
item.description: A g1 survey reveals that 34% of Flávio Bolsonaro's donors also funded Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, while Lula retained only 1.4% of recurring donors. Most of Flávio's recurring donors are businesspeople linked to agribusiness, with donations exceeding R$100,000. Lula's donors are connected to the government, with smaller contributions ranging from R$1,000 to R$27,000.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é orientado a baixar o tom, e Lula, a evitar provocações no debate da Globo
item.description: The campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro adjust strategies for the Globo debate after criticism of the first confrontation; Flávio should reduce confrontations and prioritize proposals, while Lula avoids provocations. Polls show an increase in undecided voters.

item.title: Como será o debate presidencial da Globo? Entenda as regras
item.description: The presidential debate on TV Globo between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula will take place on Friday, October 23, at 9:20 PM, live from the Globo Studios. The format includes four Q&A blocks focusing on government plans, with real-time fact-checking by Fato ou Fake. The full content will be available on Globoplay and g1 after the event.

item.title: Debate presidencial da Globo: quando será e onde assistir
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will take place on Friday, October 23, at 9:20 PM BRT, after the Nightly News, at Globo Studios in Rio de Janeiro. The debate will be broadcast live on TV Globo, GloboNews, and g1, moderated by journalist César Tralli. Prior to the debate, each candidate will be interviewed individually by journalist Renata Lo Prete.

item.title: A última pesquisa Quaest para presidente antes do segundo turno entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The latest Quaest poll before the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro shows a technical tie, with 46% for Lula and 47% for Flávio. The margin of error is two percentage points, based on 3,702 in-person interviews. The race reflects responses to statements about Bolsa Família and street mobilizations.

item.title: TSE reúne representantes de redes sociais após Nunes Marques ordenar pente-fino em canal de apoio a Lula
item.description: The TSE will meet on Friday with representatives from digital platforms, including Meta, Google, and X, to align actions for the second round of elections following Minister Kássio Nunes Marques' order to investigate the 'Exército do Lula' channel for suspected coordinated content amplification. The measure responds to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which accuses the channel of artificially boosting pro-Lula messages. The closed-door meeting will include ministers specialized in electoral advertising.

item.title: Vai chover no dia da eleição? Veja a previsão para todas as regiões do Brasil
item.description: In the 2026 runoff elections, weather conditions vary significantly across Brazil's regions, with rain in the Southeast and South, and intense heat in the North, Northeast, and Center-West. The forecast indicates instability risks in the Center-West, with possible irregular rain showers, while capitals like Palmas and Manaus may reach high temperatures of up to 39 °C.

item.title: Lula e Flávio encerram campanha com agendas em São Paulo, Minas e Rio, que concentram 40% do eleitorado
item.description: Lula and Flávio wrap up their campaigns in Brazil's three most populous states — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — which together account for 39.9% of voters. Flávio leads in the Southeast (48% vs 39%), but is statistically tied nationally (45% vs 44%). Both campaigns focus on reducing voter abstention, particularly among those over 70.

item.title: Brasil virou terreno fértil para extrema direita, diz pesquisadora
item.description: Chilean researcher Marta Lagos notes that Latin America, including Brazil, has become fertile ground for the far-right, driven by a demand for governments that take care of people. The ideological shift reflects an appeal for security and governance rather than specific economic policies. The research highlights a regional trend of growing right-wing support following cycles of progressive governments.

item.title: Após pedido de Lula, PF começa a investigar disputa entre Richarlison e amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Following a request by President Lula, the Federal Police began investigating a dispute over a mansion on Ilha Comprida involving Richarlison and Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro. The footballer accuses the senator and lawyer of attempting to strip him of ownership of the property, where he claims to have invested around R$ 10 million. The investigation was added to an ongoing inquiry at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Flávio ou Lula? Quem está na frente nas últimas pesquisas para presidente
item.description: The latest Quaest and Datafolha polls keep Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a technical tie for the second round, with a two-point margin of error. Quaest shows 45% for Flávio and 44% for Lula, while Datafolha indicates 47% and 46% respectively. Rising undecided voters and stability in spontaneous polls highlight the tight race.

item.title: Lula libera abertura de sigilos, mas dados seguem restritos; entenda
item.description: Lula's campaign filed authorization documents with the TSE to waive banking and phone secrecy, but no data has been released. The next step is whether Justice Minister Mendonça will order federal agencies to disclose the records. Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet submitted the requested waivers, including for the offshore firm Alcazar Holdings.

item.title: “Bloco do 22” toma ruas de capitais no Nordeste a 3 dias do 2º turno
item.description: The 'Bloco do 22', a pro-Bolsonaro movement, held rallies in Maceió, Recife, and Mossoró, featuring walks and gatherings at 6:22 PM and 7:22 PM. The mobilization included appearances by right-wing figures like Carlos Bolsonaro, Nikolas Ferreira, and Gilson Machado Neto, and sold branded shirts with Bolsonaro's face to fund campaign materials. The events took place three days before the 2026 runoff election.

item.title: Lula promete “novo jeito de governar” em caso de reeleição
item.description: Lula pledged a new governance model if reelected, emphasizing popular participation and civic mobilization in the campaign. The live stream, part of the Lula Army, featured celebrity endorsements and aimed to boost engagement ahead of the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula entrega documentos e pede TSE como "árbitro" de sigilos
item.description: Lula's campaign submitted banking, telematic, and phone secrecy documents to the TSE, responding to a challenge against Flávio Bolsonaro. The team requested the court to act as an arbitrator to validate and simultaneously disclose the financial data of both candidates, against the ruling of Minister André Mendonça. Edinho Silva emphasized judicial oversight and transparency to ensure data credibility.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula e de Flávio Bolsonaro se engajam para tentar virar votos de indecisos
item.description: Supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro share posts on social media platform X to court undecided voters, discussing economic policies such as the Pix payment system and making remarks about the previous government. The cited post illustrates the digital activism of followers, using themes like economy and corruption to sway voters. The content reflects the escalation of campaigning ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Trump pode gostar mais de outro candidato, mas vai respeitar resultado se Lula vencer, diz Celso Amorim
item.description: Celso Amorim states that Donald Trump, despite preferring another candidate, will respect the electoral outcome if Lula wins reelection. He notes Trump will not acknowledge it cheerfully but will accept the victory in practice. The statement comes three days before the 2026 Brazilian election runoff.

item.title: Carreira de Flávio Bolsonaro como advogado só decola no Senado, com Willer Tomaz e foco no STJ
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expanded his legal career after being elected senator in 2018, handling criminal, civil, and corporate cases with a focus on the STJ. His work as a lawyer gained visibility following his relocation to Brasília and his alliance with figures like Willer Tomaz.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se alinhou ao pai e reproduziu narrativas em momentos críticos; relembre
item.description: In the 2026 election campaign, Flávio Bolsonaro sought to present himself as a more moderate version of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, emphasizing differences such as taking the Covid vaccine. Despite attempts to distance himself, he echoed some of his father's narratives during critical moments.

item.title: Maracanã tem entrada de adesivos políticos limitada em jogos de Vasco e Flamengo: 'Só um por pessoa'
item.description: Maracanã restricted political stickers at Vasco and Flamengo games, allowing only one per fan, following a directive from the Specialized Stadium Policing Battalion (Bepe) amid the Brazilian presidential election. The measure sparked criticism and disappointment among supporters.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha mostra a distância entre Flávio e Lula nas regiões do Brasil
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the South, Southeast, and North/Central-West regions, while Lula dominates the Northeast. Nationally, both candidates tie at 50% of valid votes. The electoral race reveals strong regional polarization, with substantial margins between the candidates across different areas.

item.title: Lula pede a Mendonça que faça mediação de quebras de sigilo dele e de Flávio
item.description: Lula asks the TSE and Justice Minister André Mendonça to mediate the disclosure of bank and telematic data between his campaign and Flávio Bolsonaro's. The petition seeks to ensure transparency and simultaneous release of information by both sides. Mendonça had already ruled out judicial intervention, stating candidates may freely disclose their own data.

item.title: A grande surpresa da eleição de 2026 na disputa entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: The left's entry into social media emerges as a surprise in the 2026 election, with Lula and Flávio holding simultaneous live streams. Political scientist Elias Tavares highlights the reorganization of the PT's digital communication, though he questions the effectiveness of live broadcasts in reaching undecided voters. Communities like 'Lula's Army' and 'Flávio's Troop' mobilize millions on digital platforms.

item.title: De camisetas a celular na cabine: o que pode e o que não pode no dia da votação
item.description: In the second round of Brazil’s 2026 presidential election, voters may wear flags, T-shirts, and stickers representing candidate colors but are barred from collective protests, using phones in voting booths, and canvassing. Voting runs from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Brasília time, with electronic devices stored on tables near booths. The electoral court emphasizes individual, silent voting.

item.title: Lula pede que Mendonça cobre de Flávio a abertura de sigilos
item.description: Lula and Flávio are at odds over the disclosure of bank, tax, and phone records. The PT campaign requested that Minister André Mendonça mandate simultaneous publication of both candidates' data. So far, only access powers have been submitted, with no actual data released.

item.title: Datafolha: PT fala em onda pró-Lula, e aliados de Flávio citam força da direita na véspera de eleições
item.description: Datafolha poll shows a tie in the presidential race three days before the runoff. Flávio Bolsonaro highlights resistance to Lula's attacks, while PT emphasizes government evaluation and rejection of the rival. Campaigns prepare for October 22nd voting.

item.title: Datafolha: Veja intenção de voto em Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro por gênero, idade, renda e religião
item.description: The October 22, 2026 Datafolha poll shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), each securing 50% of valid votes in the second round. The coverage highlights the candidates' performance but does not mention specific topics such as economy, security, or health.

item.title: Lula participa de live do “exército” e estimula ida de idosos às urnas
item.description: Lula took part in a live stream with André Janones from the 'Lula Army', encouraging especially the elderly to vote in the second round. During the broadcast, he highlighted social policies and the expansion of the Pé-de-Meia program for university students. Flávio Bolsonaro had no public campaign agenda on Thursday.

item.title: Empate no Datafolha enterra esperança de debate propositivo na Globo, dizem aliados de Flávio e Lula
item.description: The Datafolha survey released this Friday (23) shows a tie between the candidates, undermining hopes held by allies of Lula and Flávio for a more substantive Globo debate, as promised to replace the format of the Band. The expectation of a more nuanced, proposal-focused dialogue was shaken by the balanced voting intentions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro muda estratégia em debate para conter rejeição, e Lula tenta evitar provocações
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro adjusts his debate strategy to reduce personal rejection, while Lula avoids provocations to maintain a stable image. Both aim to consolidate support without engaging in direct criticism.

item.title: Como 47% a 46% no Datafolha pode virar empate de 50% a 50% entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: A one-point advantage in Datafolha polls may turn into a 50%-50% tie between Lula and Flávio when blank, null, and undecided votes are excluded from valid votes. The rounding of published percentages hides small differences in exact values, potentially changing the final outcome.

item.title: Janones convoca apoiadores para atos de Lula no sábado
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) called on supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) to participate in rallies in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo on Saturday (October 24, 2026), the day before the presidential runoff. He emphasized the significance of the events as a final campaign mobilization, though he clarified that it is not Lula's last political appearance. The gatherings are scheduled for 9 AM in Rio, at Copacabana, and 2 PM in São Paulo, on Paulista Avenue.

item.title: Lula faz live com Janones após Datafolha apontar empate com Flávio
item.description: President Lula held a live stream with federal deputy André Janones after Datafolha showed a tie between him and Flávio Bolsonaro at 50% of valid votes, ahead of Sunday's election. The broadcast, lasting over an hour, aimed to rally supporters amid tight electoral competition.

item.title: Campanha de Lula recorre a Mendonça por mediação do TSE e pressiona Flávio por quebras de sigilo
item.description: The Lula campaign (PT) appealed to TSE minister André Mendonça to request mediation in releasing the banking, tax, and phone confidentiality of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The request seeks transparency in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Especialistas apontam farsa e piada por trás da guerra sobre sigilos entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The dispute between Lula and Flávio over the opening of confidentiality files was classified as a farce by specialists, who emphasize the political nature of the controversy and the impossibility of effective analysis by voters in such a short time. Minister André Mendonça clarified that candidates can voluntarily disclose their data, but the exchange of demands between campaigns offers few conditions for well-founded conclusions.

item.title: PGR se manifesta contra divulgação de visitas de Vorcaro e mulher de Moraes ao Senado
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office (PGR) opposed the release of records regarding visits by Daniel Vorcaro and Viviane Barci de Moraes to the Senate, arguing that a writ of mandamus is not the appropriate legal tool to obtain such data. The case, which also involves relatives of Lula and lawmaker-elect Guilherme Kilter, will be reviewed by Justice Luiz Fux. Leaked messages suggest close contact between Attorney General Paulo Gonet and the banker, as well as requests to halt investigations into Banco Master.
